master_output.idea:
Core idea: Introduce a dynamic class-weighted loss function that adapts during training by inversely scaling class weights based on the model's current per-class confidence scores, forcing it to prioritize underrepresented or misclassified classes in subsequent epochs.  

Non-trivial crux: Ensuring the adaptive weighting mechanism avoids overfitting to transient performance fluctuations while maintaining computational efficiency during training.
